recognize_zh: 脂肪為主的低細胞性骨髓切片中，許多間質內小型細胞呈棕色核染（Cyclin D1 核陽性），散布在脂肪細胞之間、部分成小群，與藍色的陰性造血細胞交錯，符合毛細胞白血病浸潤。
features: Numerous small to medium cells with brown nuclear staining distributed interstitially between adipocytes, singly and in loose clusters
Positive nuclei round to oval, of variable intensity
Interspersed negative (hematoxylin blue) hematopoietic cells, including small clusters
No paratrabecular or nodular aggregates in this field
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a hypocellular, fat-rich bone marrow core biopsy shows numerous small to medium-sized cells with nuclear positivity for cyclin D1, distributed singly and in loose clusters in an interstitial pattern between adipocytes. Negative hematopoietic cells, including erythroid clusters, are interspersed. The interstitial distribution and widely spaced cells are characteristic of hairy cell leukemia. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmation with CD20, annexin A1, TRAP/CD123 and BRAF V600E is recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL shows strong, uniform cyclin D1 with SOX11 positivity and paratrabecular/nodular aggregates of CD5+ cells, whereas HCL has weak-to-moderate cyclin D1 in an interstitial CD5-, annexin A1+ infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL variant is annexin A1-, CD25-, BRAF wild-type and usually cyclin D1 negative.
SMZL has an intrasinusoidal and nodular pattern and is cyclin D1 and annexin A1 negative.
These lack a CD20+ cyclin D1+ lymphoid infiltrate between the fat cells.
